H. P. Lovecraft, Short Fiction.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/h-p-lovecraft/short-fiction

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- H. P. Lovecraft, an annotator and author, died 1937.

First publication of the text used: between 1905 and 1935 (SE colophon: 'Short Fiction was compiled from short stories and novellas written and published between 1905 and 1935 by H. P. Lovecraft.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in between 1905 and 1935. The edition's own statement of rights (quoted below) says the text is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each has a term of life + 70 years or less. The last person to die did so in 1937, so the text is public domain in each of them.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon (quoted above): publication year between 1905 and 1935.
- Wikidata Q169566 (H. P. Lovecraft), P570 = 1937-03-15
